per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_4_publication_grade: No blocking/major owner-layer issue remains open after re-review; residual issues are explicit nonblocking cautions.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Material packet status remains material_extracted_with_gaps because landing*.bin supplementary assets are HTML/indexed-only, but OA package contains the paper XML/PDF, Table_1.DOCX, Table_2.DOCX, figures, and PDF text needed for worker-4/6 adjudication.

Primary Table 1 contains misspelled Vibrio labels while database rows use normalized organism spellings; these rows remain source_conflict with CGMCC/value context rather than being silently normalized.
Linked DBAASP/CAMP/dbAMP rows for SpHyastatin (81-115) are CRD-domain records and were reconciled to the CRD SpHyastatin MIC column, not the full-length SpHyastatin columns.

adjudication_summary: Worker-4/6 source re-review reconciled the CRD-domain database rows to primary Table 1, preserved database/source spelling conflicts as cautions, replaced framework placeholder mechanism notes, and closed the targeted rework ticket after strict gates passed.
